findings.reason: F0003:S4:T2:A22 reports modal values from triplicate experiments and also states Single reading. Their relationship is unspecified. Medium and assay observation time are NOT_FOUND. EUCAST and CLSI results must remain distinct, including NCCPF 760690 values of 0.25 and 0.125 mg/liter respectively; these method-specific values are not silently reconciled.
findings.needed_material: Clarify the scope of Single reading and the relationship to triplicate experiments, and supply susceptibility medium and timing metadata before accepting MIC measurement context.

findings.reason: Strain-linked MIC body values and source provenance are available. The associated Diagnosis entries do not establish mouse host health or immune status. This page supplies no dosing history, treatment day, animal experimental units, detection limits or missing-value definitions. Their absence from this page does not establish absence elsewhere.
findings.needed_material: During preparation, retain the five source columns and both method-specific MIC series; assess applicable metadata against authorized study records and preserve unresolved fields without inventing animal identities or dose histories.

findings.reason: MI010 remains status DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at index, originating in main:/missing_information/items/9. Its affected field remains Eligible matched PK/PD records: comparable index regressions and supported targets cannot yet be established. Four A. flavus isolate MIC pairs are available, but this page does not establish response-record matching, regimen-specific exposure identifiers, free-exposure basis, exposure windows, response windows or a common comparison set for DRQ021–DRQ025. The mouse-model title does not establish those relationships. Matching must remain separate by organism and endpoint under SC017, SC032 and SC033.
findings.needed_material: Establish source-supported links among organism/isolate MICs, response records, dosing histories and relevant free-exposure inputs, including AUC and peak definitions and fT>MIC window and duration-versus-percentage meaning; document applicability of separate PK experiments or why an index or target is not determinable. Keep independent animal PK work separately assessable.

findings.reason: This page contains isolate MIC results, but no survival observations, desired survival effect, control reference, treatment duration, follow-up window or matched exposure-response links. The title alone cannot establish eligible survival data, and no survival-target match is assigned.
findings.needed_material: Assess authorized survival-response records and project effect/window definitions separately by organism. Retain the numerical target as a planned T004 output rather than treating its unestimated value as missing source data.

findings.reason: MI013 remains status DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at prepare, originating in main:/missing_information/items/12. Its affected field remains MIC distribution preparation and probability support: a transparent MIC probability input for later weighted attainment has not been established. For DRQ031, linked notes supply Section 3b totals, C. albicans truncation at 0.016 mg/L and the separately stated 98% (4149/4237) summary. Numeric distribution bins, per-bin counts, complete censored categories and probability derivation are not supplied. The relationship between 4237 and the Section 3b C. albicans total of 13,630 is not established here. These denominators must not be interchanged. A. flavus isolate MIC rows are not a population distribution, and the ECOFF header supplies no numeric ECOFF.
findings.needed_material: At preparation, assess the authorized complete MIC tables and document bins, original units, counts, denominator scope, censoring, truncation and test method. Carry the text-only numerical summaries separately for confirmation. Record probability derivation and any normalization explicitly, preserve source categories and truncation, and freeze the resulting distribution without silent renormalization. Keep per-MIC PTA separate from MIC-weighted attainment and do not interpret ECOFF distributions as resistance rates.
